slides.title: Title Slide
slides.narration: Welcome to this Spoken Tutorial on **API**.

slides.title: Learning Objectives
slides.narration:
In this tutorial, you will learn to,

• Define what an **API** is.
• Explain the function of an **API key**.
• Identify how an **API request** is made.

slides.title: System Requirements
slides.narration: Here I am using a browser on a computer or mobile.

slides.title: Prerequisites
slides.narration: To follow this tutorial, you should have completed **Module 2: Art of the Prompt**.

slides.title: What is an API? Think of it like a Restaurant Waiter
slides.narration:
Imagine you are at a restaurant and want to order food.
What do you do?
You tell your order to the waiter, right?
The waiter takes your order to the kitchen.
Then, the kitchen prepares your food.
Finally, the waiter brings your food back to you.
An **API**, or **Application Programming Interface**, works in a similar way.
Think of an **API** like that restaurant waiter.
It takes your application's **request** to the **AI** model.
Then, it brings the **AI** model's response back to your application.
slides.image_prompt: Illustration showing API as a waiter connecting a customer (application) to a kitchen (AI model)

slides.title: API Keys and Requests
slides.narration:
Now, how does this 'waiter' know it's you?
It needs an identification.
An **API Key** is like a secret password.
It is your unique ID card for accessing the **AI** service.
This **key** tells the **AI** that you are allowed to make a **request**.
A **request** is when you send this **API key** along with your **prompt**.
You send it to the **AI** service to place your 'order'.
It's like showing your ID to enter a secure building.
slides.image_prompt: Illustration showing a key unlocking a secure gate, representing an API key for access

slides.title: Summary
slides.narration:
Let us summarize what we learned.
We defined **APIs** as messengers.
We understood **API keys** as access credentials.
We also learned about making **API requests**.

slides.title: Assignment
slides.narration:
Now as an assignment.
Explain in your own words how an **API** facilitates communication.
It connects applications and **AI** models.
Compare the results.
